items.markdown:
Tom yum ingredients center around the iconic herb trinity of `lemongrass, galangal, and makrut lime leaves, combined with fresh shrimp, fish sauce, and lime juice`.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/tom-yum-goong/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/tom-yum-goong/)[[2]](https://www.recipetineats.com/tom-yum-soup-thai/)

Essential Herbs and Aromatics

- **Lemongrass:** 2 stalks, smashed and cut into 2-inch pieces
- **Galangal:** 6 to 8 slices of the firm, ginger-like root
- **Makrut Lime Leaves (Kaffir):** 5 to 6 fresh or frozen leaves, torn
- **Thai Chili Peppers:** 2 to 4 bird's eye chilies, smashed or chopped
- **Shallots:** 2 to 3 small shallots, peeled and bruised[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/tom-yum-goong/) [[1]](https://thewoksoflife.com/tom-yum-soup/)[[2]](https://lionbrand.com.au/recipes/tom-yum-goong-recipe-thai-hot-and-sour-soup/)

Protein and Vegetables

- **Shrimp:** 12 to 15 medium-to-large shrimp (head-on and shell-on preferred to make a rich stock)
- **Mushrooms:** 7 ounces of oyster, straw, or shimeji mushrooms
- **Tomatoes:** 2 tomatoes, cut into wedges
- **Coriander/Cilantro:** A small handful of fresh leaves for final garnish[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/tom-yum-goong/) [[1]](https://www.eatingthaifood.com/tom-yum-soup-recipe/)[[2]](https://www.aspicyperspective.com/tom-yum-soup-hot-and-sour-soup/)

Seasonings and Broth

- **Stock or Water:** 4 cups of water or homemade shrimp/chicken stock
- **Fish Sauce:** 3 tablespoons (adjusted to taste)
- **Lime Juice:** 1/2 cup of fresh lime juice (added off the heat)
- **Thai Chili Paste (*Nam Prik Pao*):** 1/4 cup for a richer, slightly sweet and savory creamy broth (optional)
- **Sugar:** 1 teaspoon to balance the sharp sour and salty notes[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/tom-yum-goong/)
